description: Golden / regression PVs (P4 model governance). Frozen known-good PVs for the full 38-trade book, pinned to an immutable market-data snapshot + valuation date. The governance gate fails if any PV drifts beyond tolerance — catching silent changes from a refactor, a QuantLib upgrade, or a market-data change. RE-BASELINE deliberately (regenerate via scripts/pricer or the governance runner) only after reviewing why a PV moved.
rebaseline_history: 2026-07-12 (A1 curve granularity): extended the SOFR par-tenor grid past 10Y (added 12Y/15Y/20Y real nodes + a constant-forward-extrapolated 30Y) so the long end is no longer flat off the 10Y node. Reviewed drivers: TRADE_18 META-2054 -1.64% and TRADE_17 ORCL-2053 -1.38% (long corp bonds were over-valued discounting on a flat long end), TRADE_23 5Yx10Y swaption -0.28%, TRADE_15/16/19 corp bonds <0.03%, TRADE_22/24/26 rates/FX <0.02%. Snapshot unchanged (only curve-construction code changed).

2026-07-12 (A2 CDS hazard term structure): single-name CDS with >=2 clean par-spread tenors now bootstrap a piecewise-flat hazard curve (ISDA-consistent) instead of one flat hazard. Only TRADE_28 ORCL moves (+1.02%: has a 1Y/5Y curve at this date, steep IG shape); TRADE_29 META and TRADE_30 CDX stay flat (thin / index) and are byte-identical. Snapshot unchanged (only credit code changed).

2026-07-12 (A3 corp-bond Z-spread term structure): corporate bonds whose issuer CDS feed gives >=2 tenors now discount on a Z-spread term structure (per-tenor CDS spread + maturity-interpolated SOFR-Treasury basis) instead of one flat 5Y Z-spread. Only TRADE_17 ORCL-2053 moves (+0.49%: its <5Y cashflows now use the lower front spread of a steep IG curve, 1Y~44bp vs flat ~219bp). TRADE_18 META (single 5Y -> flat) and the config-fallback issuers (AAPL/MSFT/AMZN) are unchanged. Snapshot unchanged (only bond credit-curve code changed).

2026-07-12 (B1 discrete dividends): American option legs on dividend-paying underliers now price with a projected discrete ex-dividend schedule (correct early-exercise timing) whose amounts are scaled to preserve the chain-implied forward, so only the American early-exercise value moves. TRADE_7 AAPL LEAPS call +0.22% (ATM call captures the early-exercise premium), TRADE_9 MSFT / TRADE_14 QQQ small +, TRADE_10 META put spread -0.11%, TRADE_8 NVDA tiny. TRADE_11 TSLA (non-payer) and the SPX Europeans (TRADE_12/13) unchanged. Snapshot unchanged (only equity-option code changed).

2026-07-12 (B3 TWD spot source): USD/TWD spot now reads the CBC NDF fixing (the reference the non-deliverable TWD book settles against) instead of Fed H.10, which was stale from ~05-29. Only TRADE_26 USD/TWD CCS moves (+1.03% at 05-29: spot 31.37->31.384, a small spot move but a large fraction of the small net CCS PV; at the live 2026-07-10 date the effect is far larger, ~+18%, as the fresh CBC 32.18 replaces the 6-week-stale Fed H.10 31.37). TRADE_27 USD/JPY unchanged. snapshot_id changes because TWD now consumes a different market-data file.

2026-07-12 (C1 rates vol term structure): the single flat MOVE-anchored normal vol is shaped into an expiry-dependent term structure via a stylized config multiplier (a documented modeling assumption anchored to MOVE, NOT a market surface). Each rate option gets its expiry's vol and the Bermudan co-terminal calibration sees a real vol slope (which identifies the Hull-White mean reversion). Mild shape (~0.97 at 5Y): TRADE_23 5Yx10Y swaption -3.0%, TRADE_24 Bermudan -2.4% (a=0.024, tree/FD cross-check 0.6% still holds), TRADE_25 1Y cap -0.9%. Only #23-25 move; snapshot unchanged.

2026-07-15 (baseline date -> live default): moved the golden baseline from valuation_date 2026-05-29 to the portfolio default 2026-07-10 (aggressive book), so a default governance_runner (which prices at the portfolio default) passes without --valuation-date. All 30 PVs re-marked at 2026-07-10; snapshot_id unchanged (d9be3d481c8244bf) (the snapshot fingerprints the on-disk market-data files, which are identical at both dates; only the valuation date and thus the marks changed). Notable 6-week moves: TRADE_27 USD/JPY forward and TRADE_11 TSLA option repriced materially on spot/vol moves. Pricing code unchanged.

2026-07-24 (market-intelligence P0 data refresh): snapshot_id d9be3d481c8244bf -> 719afc6717bc078b. PROVENANCE-ONLY re-baseline: ALL 30 PVs are byte-identical (governance reported 0 breaks / 0 missing) -- NO PV was re-marked, and NO pricing/curve/model code changed. The snapshot_id moved solely because P0's B0 step re-ran the options-chains ingest, which re-fetched the 7 PRICED chains (AAPL/NVDA/MSFT/META/TSLA/SPX/QQQ) and appended fresh CBOE delayed-quote snapshots; the upsert re-serialized those files, changing their SHA-256s. The 7 new signal-only chains (TSM/AVGO/MU/ORCL/AMZN/XLK/SMH) are written to options/chains_signals/ and are DELIBERATELY excluded from the pricer snapshot glob, and the new/refreshed vol indices are risk-only -- none of P0's new feeds are in the pricing fingerprint. The prior baseline bytes are unrecoverable (CBOE serves current quotes only), so restoring d9be... was not possible. The de-alias (EQVOL_QQQ->VXN, 5 VIX-proxy names collapsed into EQVOL_VIX) is a RISK-config change and does not touch golden PVs.

2026-07-26 (core rebalance -> promote to default): the active default book was promoted from the 'aggressive' profile to the new 'core' (Aggressive-Balanced) profile (docs/design/portfolio_rebalance_review.md) - restores most hedges (hedge_scale 0.5->0.85), caps single-name notionals (notional_cap 20%->12%), and de-levers the negative-skew carry. All 30 PVs re-marked to the core notionals at 2026-07-10 (gross 3.68x->2.74x, book PV 1.69bn->1.25bn, 1-day 99% VaR 30.9mm->24.3mm). snapshot_id unchanged (market-data files identical; only position sizes changed). No pricing/curve/model code changed.

2026-07-26 (Part 2 rebalance -> new diversifier sleeves): added 6 positions (portfolio_rebalance_review.md Part 2) — CEG/VST (AI-power), GOOGL (hyperscaler), GLD (gold ballast, own risk factor), a deeper-OTM SPX convexity put, and a 1Y-UST liquidity buffer — taking the book to 36 trades. The sizing optimizer gained a final scale-to-budget step (re-scales after the notional cap when it trims an offsetting short), so every book now respects its VaR budget: core = 2.0% (gross 2.74x->2.02x), a genuinely more balanced book with the new sleeves sharing the risk budget. ALL 36 PVs re-marked (existing trades re-sized). snapshot_id changes (prices_daily.csv gained CEG/VST/GOOGL/GLD); no pricing/curve/model code changed. CEG/VST/GOOGL are XLK-risk-proxied (EQ_XLK_PROXY_P2); GLD has its own factor.

2026-07-27 (Part 2 refinement -> CEG/VST/GOOGL own factors): replaced the shared EQ_XLK_PROXY_P2 risk proxy with dedicated EQ_CEG/EQ_VST/EQ_GOOGL factors (own price series, already on disk) + added them to _EQUITY_TICKERS. The VaR/Sigma model now credits their real (lower) correlation to semis instead of treating them as XLK beta. Re-sizing re-marked ALL 36 PVs; core stays 2.0% VaR (gross 2.02x->2.13x -- diversification lets the book hold more at the same budget), AI-capex-bust tail 159->152mm. snapshot_id UNCHANGED (config-only change; no market-data files touched -- prices_daily.csv already carried the 4 names). No pricing/curve/model code changed.

2026-07-27 (N5 semis dispersion pair): added TRADE_37 INTC (long) + TRADE_38 AMD (short) -- a beta-neutral semis dispersion pair (long laggard / short leader), taking the book to 38 trades. Own factors EQ_INTC/EQ_AMD (a shared proxy would net the correlated long/short to ~zero risk and erase the dispersion). New optimizer feature market_neutral_pairs pins the short leg to short_ratio x the long (0.636 = beta_INTC/beta_AMD) for beta-neutrality, overriding the return-tilt that would floor the negative-carry short. Net pair beta ~0; core stays ~2.0% VaR (gross 2.00x), AI-capex-bust tail 152->148mm. ALL 38 PVs re-marked. snapshot_id changes (prices_daily.csv gained INTC/AMD). No pricing/curve/model code changed.

2026-07-27 (realized single-name risk-share cap): added the optimizer's final risk_share_cap step (docs/design/portfolio_rebalance_review.md) -- bounds each single name's REALIZED component-VaR share of net book risk, closing the Part 1 caveat that concentration_cap only bounded the intended *directional* risk budget (which left MU ~24% of net risk). Core now caps every single name at 18% of net risk (MU 23.6%->18.0%; TSM/NVDA/MU all sit at the 0.18 cap). De-concentration lets the book run to its exact VaR budget (19.4->20.0mm) at slightly higher gross (2.00x->2.18x): MU notional trimmed -17%, the other directional names grew ~+10% to fill the freed budget. ALL 38 PVs re-marked (position sizes only). snapshot_id UNCHANGED (9c860c42ca21ab33; no market-data files touched). No pricing/curve/model code changed.

2026-10-06 (roll + baseline date -> 2026-10-06): full market-data refresh (all 14 ingest steps + EOD re-pull of equity/options/credit/MOVE after the close; Pensford SOFR curve from the live Supabase source, first reset 2026-10-06) and the book's default_valuation_date moved 2026-07-10 -> 2026-10-06. Five trades had expired since the 07-10 baseline and were ROLLED (see roll_history in the portfolio files): TRADE_9 MSFT 3M call spread 400/430@09-18 -> 545/585@2027-01-15, TRADE_11 TSLA 1M straddle 400@07-17 -> 380@11-20, TRADE_12 SPX 3M put 7550@09-18 -> 7850@2027-01-15, TRADE_14 QQQ 3M collar 700/780@09-18 -> 730/810@2027-01-15 (same tenor; strikes keep inception K/S vs the 06-17 chain, snapped to listed strikes), TRADE_27 USD/JPY 3M fwd 157.50@08-31 -> 156.94@2027-01-08 (struck at the fair forward, PV ~665). All 38 PVs re-marked; reviewed drivers: SOFR curve +40-75bp (10Y par 4.14) -> payer swap TRADE_22 +1.6mm, long bonds down (TRADE_17 META-2053 -13.6; ORCL CDS widened -> TRADE_28 (buy protection) +49 1,112.7mm). Pricing code unchanged.

2026-10-08 (credit-sdr-dedup): the DTCC credit feeds now keep every record (keyed on Dissemination Identifier, CORR/EROR applied) instead of one row per day, and the CDS/bond adapters price only from price-forming prints (NEWT + Event type TRAD, windowed by execution date, no look-ahead); the bonds corp-CDS feed is retired. Re-ingested 270 business days. Reviewed drivers (2026-10-06): TRADE_28 ORCL CDS -12.5% (5Y 213.5bp from 4 prints -> 198.75bp from 178); TRADE_29 META CDS -341.8k -> -155.2k (config fallback, 1 print -> 88.0bp from 89); TRADE_30 CDX.NA.IG -0.7% (51.11bp from 41 rows incl. 3 MODI -> 51.45bp from 27,006); TRADE_17 ORCL-2053 -3.4% (credit curve gains a 7Y node at 290bp, which now sets the flat long end; was flat past 5Y at 257bp); TRADE_18 META-2054 -4.65% (config fallback Z 95bp -> DTCC 131bp at 5Y). Other 33 trades unchanged within tolerance; IPV passes. Snapshot 49f0612a3f4a5f8e -> 39bdd9098ca6ae06 (credit files re-ingested; bonds corp-CDS file no longer an input).

2026-10-08 (credit-sdr-dedup review P2): the credit feeds keep records from keep_from_date 2025-05-01 (was a 270-business-day window counted back from the run date) so every pinned valuation date has its full 365d lookback; re-ingested 2025-05-01..2025-09-24. Snapshot 39bdd9098ca6ae06 -> cd87a74c2e38b0af. No 2026-10-06 PV changed (0 breaks: their window starts 2025-10-06, already on disk). The 2026-05-29 per-asset pin TRADE_28 moved 969,618.66 -> 971,580.58 (+0.20%) now that its window has full history.

SIZES ONLY: snapshot cd87a74c2e38b0af unchanged, pricing code unchanged. The trailing 250d window is calmer than July's, so each profile buys ~18-28% more gross for the same VaR budget (core gross 2.18x -> 2.80x, VaR99 $20.0mm on budget). Book PV 1,107.2mm -> 1,393.4mm. Same valuation date, so test_governance VDATE is unchanged.
